title: Ek Deewane ki Deewaniyat
desc: When a powerful politician falls for a strong-willed superstar, their intense romance spirals into a perilous clash of desire and ego, turning love into a battle of passion and heartbreak.

title: Tezaab
desc: After his parents' murder, Mahesh is imprisoned and separated from Mohini, who suffers under her cruel father. Years later, he returns to rescue her and avenge his past.

title: Mr. & Mrs. Khiladi
desc: An astrologer foretells a bright future for Raja, an idle young man, who falls for Shalu, a millionaire's daughter. Her father insists Raja must work hard and earn money to win her hand.

title: Kakuda
desc: A newlywed bride, fearing her husband will die in 13 days due to a village ghost's curse, seeks the help of a ghost hunter to save him from the looming danger.

title: Phone Bhoot
desc: Two young men start a ghost-catching business inspired by childhood stories. Their work turns dangerous when they must face a poltergeist and keep a promise that could cost them dearly.

title: Kasoor
desc: Shekhar, accused of killing his wife, hires Simran, a flawless lawyer. Convinced of his innocence, she grows close to him, unaware of his dangerous true intentions.

title: Aitraaz
desc: Raj, a married man, is falsely accused of rape by his ex-girlfriend, now his boss's wife. Pushed to the edge, he fights back by suing her for sexual harassment despite pressure.

title: Pure Bollywood
desc: Bollywood songs - catchy, emotional, and upbeat - dominate the charts. From heartbreak to celebration, these tracks capture every mood, making people dance, cry, and sing along everywhere.

title: Ek Aur Ek Gyarah
desc: Tara and Sitara, thieves, hide in Major Ram Singh's house. When Cobra kidnaps their mother, they must deceive Ram to save her and free Panther.

title: Hai Jawani Toh Ishq Hona Hai
desc: When family planning disagreements end their marriage, Jas finds love abroad, but hidden secrets and tangled relationships soon complicate his new beginning.

title: Zindagi Na Milegi Dobara
desc: Kabir, Imran, and Arjun set off on a vacation in Spain before Kabir's wedding, where the journey helps them mend bonds, heal old wounds, embrace life, and face their deepest fears.

title: Singham Again
desc: When ruthless enemies kidnap his beloved wife, fearless police officer Bajirao Singham rallies his trusted force to execute a high-stakes, explosive rescue mission and bring justice.

title: The Bhootnii
desc: Heartbroken Shantanu seeks true love under the Virgin Tree, but things spiral when Mohabbat, a lovestruck ghost, begins obsessing over him and turns his life upside down.

title: Sabdham
desc: Paranormal investigator Rooban helps restless spirits find peace, but his life turns upside down when he faces a vengeful entity determined to unleash complete chaos on everyone.

title: Dabangg 2
desc: Chulbul Pandey, a fearless cop, kills a corrupt politician's brother, sparking revenge. When his wife is attacked, an enraged Chulbul takes on his enemies to protect his family.

title: Mr. India
desc: Arun shelters a group of orphans and is harassed by a gangster eyeing his house. After a child dies, he uses his father's invisibility watch to fight back.
